reuse.why: Extracts the local unlink update from unlinkAccount into clearAccountLink and calls it from both unlinkAccount and the link path, reusing the existing already-linked query and closed-account guard.

duplication.why: The field-clearing update exists once and is shared, so the takeover leaves an account exactly as unlinkAccount does without copying it.

placement.why: The flag joins LinkAccountBaseParams and the logic stays in linkBankSyncAccount, the shared path all provider link handlers use; the helper sits beside unlinkAccount.

scope.why: Only the flag, the takeover step, the extraction and tests.

maintainability.why: Small, well-named helper that deliberately skips the provider-side part of unlinkAccount, and the takeover runs after the closed-account check so other rules are untouched.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared linkBankSyncAccount path and the extracted clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink update was moved into a helper and shared, not copied.
